student_learning_goal: I can find a bug in existing code and explain it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find a bug in existing code and explain it.
header.character_watermark: Buzz in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Find the bug in 6 buggy codes. Identify the step and type.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six buggy code rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six buggy code rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 4in. Each: code + expected outcome + 'Bug at step ___' + 'Type: ___'. Pre-filled codes. Header 'Find the Bug:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_BUGS: keywords (bug) name the rows.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each bug step and type identified.

parts.student_instructions: Trace 2 codes step by step. Where does it diverge from expected?
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Two trace tables.

image_placeholders.description: Two trace tables in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each: code on top, step-by-step trace, 'Diverges at step: ___'. Header 'Trace:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_TRACE: keywords (trace) name the tables.

parts.student_instructions: Write your own buggy code. Plant a bug. Describe the bug.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Blank code area.

image_placeholders.description: A blank code area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'My code: ___'. 'My bug: ___'. Header 'My Buggy Code:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_MY: keywords (buggy) name the area.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and find each other's bugs.
